infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ProSpray records your location when you clock in and out, and every few minutes while you are clocked in with the app open, to verify job-site attendance. It is not recorded when you are off the clock.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: ProSpray records your location when you clock in and out, and every few minutes while you are clocked in with the app open, to verify job-site attendance. It is not recorded when you are off the clock.

plugins.cameraPermission: ProSpray uses the camera to scan QR labels on vehicles and equipment, and to photograph documents, fuel receipts and your profile photo.
